notes.title: Paraná Version 4
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Updated the main menu to include actual textures for the VHS tapes as well as the VCR
[*] Fixed bug that allowed players to walk into each other when pushing each other into walls
[*] Removed redundant player state and migrated all physics logic to physics core, leading to fewer bugged physics interactions
[*] Updated the animation system so that grabs look better
[*] Updated the animation system to allow for more diverse damage animations
[*] Cleaned up existing damage animations and added some new damage animations thanks to the new system
[*] Disabled language feature in pause menu as its functionality was incomplete
[*] Disabled post-match pausing
[*] Added hitlag
[*] Players reset their position between rounds
[*] Added alternate palettes for Slate's preview in the character select menu
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: The Cutting Room Floor Gets Swept
notes.notes:
Hello, it's time for some quality of life updates.

Since the first public release of the playtest, I've been working on a lot of small changes to make my life easier while adding new content and to improve the user experience. In addition, I've made a completely new banner that's seen in the library.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Updated the main menu to include actual textures for the VHS tapes as well as the VCR
[*] Fixed bug that allowed players to walk into each other when pushing each other into walls
[*] Removed redundant player state and migrated all physics logic to physics core, leading to fewer bugged physics interactions
[*] Updated the animation system so that grabs look better
[*] Updated the animation system to allow for more diverse damage animations
[*] Cleaned up existing damage animations and added some new damage animations thanks to the new system
[*] Disabled language feature in pause menu as its functionality was incomplete
[*] Disabled post-match pausing
[*] Added hitlag
[*] Players reset their position between rounds
[*] Added alternate palettes for Slate's preview in the character select menu
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]
Now that we’ve dealt with what has been done, it’s time to talk about my aspirations. To keep it simple, the playtest will be supported until I have a build with two playable characters that, while rough, have cleaned up animations. At that point, I can spend time finalizing the animations and releasing the Early Access. In addition, the stages should also hopefully be cleaned up by that time. After that, I’ll keep the playtest up a little longer and then discontinue it in lieu of the Early Access. The more I animate, the better I’ll get at it. As I get better, I’ll be able to make the animations faster and more accurately to my vision. Thanks to 7:30 Alex, I have a full document that describes the animations associated for Slate and Laura, so I don’t have to worry about coming up with moves completely from scratch.

Enjoy the new update!

Alex
